name: check_vendored_docx
logic_name: DOCX Published Source Provenance And Narrow ZIP Security Backport

test_list.description: The exact docx-rs 0.4.22 published archive and every source file are hashed, the omitted MIT license is pinned to the upstream revision, and no source files may be added or missing.
Only the two ZIP requirement edits and the ZIP 9 FileOptions lifetime edit may differ from published crate bytes.
Changing an unpatched source file fails provenance verification.
Unexpected or missing files, symlinks, license changes, or manifest edits fail closed.

output_description: Only the published crate bytes plus the narrowly authorized ZIP 9 security backport are accepted.
